categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Skyverse Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on high-end semiconductor quality control, providing comprehensive yield management solutions including equipment products, intelligent software, and related services. Its product portfolio covers optical inspection and metrology equipment for all key process steps in integrated circuit manufacturing, serving logic, memory, power semiconductors, MEMS, compound semiconductors, advanced packaging, silicon wafers, and process equipment sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary optical inspection technologies, deep ultraviolet imaging scanning, multi-mode illumination systems, high-precision interferometric metrology, and advanced data analytics including AI and big data algorithms. It develops equipment with high sensitivity, throughput, and precision, supporting advanced process nodes down to 14nm and below. The production involves precision assembly, calibration, and testing of semiconductor inspection and metrology instruments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic integrated circuit manufacturers across logic, memory, power, MEMS, compound semiconductors (SiC, GaN, GaAs), advanced packaging (2.5D/3D, wafer-level packaging), silicon wafer producers, and semiconductor process equipment companies (etch, deposition, CMP). The company serves primarily semiconductor fabrication plants and packaging foundries in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries across major cities including Shenzhen, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Xiamen, Chengdu, Wuhan, Qingdao, Tianjin, Nanjing, Zhuhai, and international subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore. Its sales and services primarily target the domestic Chinese semiconductor market, which is the largest globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Skyverse Technology operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in manufacturing and supplying semiconductor quality control equipment and software that support wafer fabrication and packaging processes. It is a key equipment supplier to semiconductor fabs and related process equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous high-level R&D investment focused on advancing optical inspection resolution, developing AI-driven defect classification and yield management software, and upgrading equipment to meet cutting-edge process nodes and packaging technologies. It emphasizes proprietary technology development, patent accumulation, and expanding product breadth and depth to break foreign monopolies and enhance domestic semiconductor equipment capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment, supplemented by sales of spare parts and provision of related software products and services. The company uses a direct sales model with contracts including equipment delivery, installation, acceptance, and after-sales support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment market is dominated by international giants such as KLA Corporation, Applied Materials, Hitachi, and others. Skyverse Technology positions itself as a leading domestic high-end semiconductor quality control equipment provider, competing directly with foreign incumbents in China and aiming to increase domestic market share amid growing localization trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.38 billion, a 54.94% year-over-year increase, driven by expanded product offerings and market penetration. Despite revenue growth, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 11.53 million due to increased R&D and stock-based compensation expenses. The company’s total assets grew 22.75% to RMB 4.21 billion, reflecting rapid scale expansion and capital investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Skyverse Technology offers a comprehensive, integrated yield management solution combining advanced optical inspection and metrology equipment with intelligent software powered by AI and big data analytics. Its products meet the stringent requirements of advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes, providing high sensitivity, accuracy, and throughput. The company emphasizes domestic innovation, customization, and localized service support to deliver competitive alternatives to foreign suppliers, enhancing customers' production yield and process control.
